Israeli cybersecurity startup Arrakis Security has raised $8 million in Seed funding to develop a platform focused on the governance of enterprise AI agents. This funding will expand its R&D and product teams in Israel, enhance detection capabilities, and support deployment among organizations using AI. Led by Hetz Ventures, the round includes notable investments from various industry leaders. The newly raised capital is crucial as enterprises face new cybersecurity challenges presented by autonomous software systems.

hits.snippet: What's the deal? Israeli cybersecurity startup Arrakis Security has raised $8 million in Seed funding to build a platform that monitors and governs the behaviour of enterprise AI agents. The round was led by Hetz Ventures, with backing from ElevenLabs chief executive officer Mati Staniszewski, Torq chief executive officer Ofer Smadari, Pentera founder and chief executive officer Amitai Ratzon, and several senior Palantir executives.
